flag_descriptions.tensor_parallel_size=8: 1.06T-param Kimi-K2.6 INT4 (~530 GiB) does not fit Hopper's 141 GiB/GPU below TP=8. Gonka's own H200 profile; not independently measured.
flag_descriptions.attention_backend=FLASHMLA: CUTLASS_MLA (pinned on the b200/b300 leaves) is sm_100+. FLASHMLA is the Hopper MLA path.
flag_descriptions.max_model_len=240000: Below Kimi's native 262144. Gonka caps it on both their Kimi profiles; b300 leaves it uncapped on 275 GiB/GPU.
flag_descriptions.VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_INT4 unset: FlashInfer's INT4 MoE kernels are trtllm-gen (Blackwell). Leaving the backend to vLLM's auto-selection matches gonka's H200 profile.
